{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter out the -1 values (missing age)
valid_age_data = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the number of valid age observations
n_valid = len(valid_age_data)

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_age_data['customer_age'].mean()

# Print all required values
print(f"Number of valid age observations: {n_valid}")
print(f"Mean age (excluding -1 values): {mean_age}")"}
